name: Amazon river turtles
description: Neotropical river turtles basking on logs and foraging across the floodplain. Functional group pooling the three Podocnemis species of the source model - the giant South American river turtle (P. expansa), the six-tubercled river turtle (P. sextuberculata) and the yellow-spotted river turtle (P. unifilis) - aggregated because the source measured the turtle fauna as one compartment; all three are heavily harvested.
